title: ops.py status: process reporting that names its source and its failures

reproduction.conclusion: the fault is intermittent; this stage fixes why a failure is unreadable when it happens, which WAS reproduced exactly

theories_tested.measurement: 0.63-0.73 s over three runs on a 471-process host; filtering the query to python processes measured 0.65 s, no better, because the cost is PowerShell startup and not enumeration
theories_tested.consequence: the narrowing optimisation was NOT made — it buys nothing and would exclude a scheduler launched under a different interpreter name

root_cause.what: the recorded reason was stderr[:200], and PowerShell echoes the whole command before the message
root_cause.historical_instance: the project's ops log, 2026-08-13: 'scheduler: scan failed ($ErrorActionPreference=...' — truncated before saying anything
root_cause.why_last_line_is_also_wrong: PowerShell's last line is the FullyQualifiedErrorId, an exception CLASS NAME; and the message itself is split across two lines by wrapping
root_cause.fix: a marker the probe writes its own message behind, plus a fallback built from the measured rendering: the first ' : ' that is not decoration, continued across wrapped lines until the position marker

tri_state_restored.defect: ProcessScan has three states by design; scheduler_processes() returns a list, and a list cannot say 'I could not look'
tri_state_restored.effect: a failed probe reached track1_status as [] -> scheduler_running=False -> track1_mode=n/a, the health check announcing Track 1 is off about a scheduler that is running
tri_state_restored.family: the same collapse the dataclass was written to end, one function later
tri_state_restored.now: scheduler_running is True | False | None; None prints as track1_mode=unknown with the reason attached

provenance_today.why_log_never_proves_running: a log line is a history; it is equally consistent with a process still going and one that died a minute later

stale_table_check.compares: the slot count the running scheduler registered (from its own log) against the count the package declares
stale_table_check.relevance: this is the check Stage 5ZY-PRE had to perform by hand

latent_defect_found_and_closed.what: the probe matched itself — the search pattern is embedded verbatim in the probe's own PowerShell command line
latent_defect_found_and_closed.why_it_had_not_bitten: both production patterns escape their dots, so their regex cannot match their own source text — an accident
latent_defect_found_and_closed.why_it_matters: ensure_single decides whether to KILL a process from this same scan
latent_defect_found_and_closed.fix: exclude the probe's own process, plus a test asserting each production pattern does not match its own source
latent_defect_found_and_closed.verified: invoked as production invokes it, a non-matching pattern returns nothing and the three real patterns return exactly the right processes

my_own_mistake_caught_by_tests.what: the first version had track1_status read the scan directly
my_own_mistake_caught_by_tests.effect: it silently bypassed the seam every existing test patches; five suites believed they had described a scheduler and were reading the real machine
my_own_mistake_caught_by_tests.principle: a test that is not isolated is worse than no test — it reports on the wrong system with full confidence
my_own_mistake_caught_by_tests.fix: rows come through scheduler_processes(); the scan is consulted only for its third state; rows are proof whatever the probe said, and only 'no rows AND could not look' is unknown

correction_to_stage_5zy_pre.why_missed: a third copy of the same argv extractor, failing with a differently-worded message ('_track1_body argv not found' rather than 'no _run([...]) call found'), so grouping by reason string put it in the pre-existing bucket
correction_to_stage_5zy_pre.why_it_matters_more_than_the_count: that test asserts no order flag can reach a Track 1 slot, and it had stopped running
correction_to_stage_5zy_pre.also_now_pins: that a phased slot carries its phase

mutations: an exception in the probe read as a definite empty scan
the printer reverting to a bare UNKNOWN
the reason reverting to the first 200 characters of stderr
a 70-against-71 slot table reported as fresh
a log line promoted to proof that the scheduler is running
repairs_to_older_suites: test_track1_ops_status_mode_20260824.py (3 cases) — seam restored, not the tests changed
test_track1_stage5k_ops_startup_20260823.py (2 cases) — seam plus the argv extractor

adjacent_suites_after.detail: a blocker-roster pin and an absence proxy asserting the live runtime tree does not exist
